carrier_note: Cerbos decides EFFECT_ALLOW or EFFECT_DENY per action; the outcome rides the rule's output block {outcome, rule} in the response
absence_note: a CEL read of a missing attribute is an evaluation error logged as a warning and the rule does not match (default EFFECT_DENY); the translation wrote has() guards on every read
human_distinct: only by the rule id in the output block; no system level cause
